correctness.rationale: For each symmetric binary stride-three circulant C_n, the symplectic toral map block [[I,C],[C,I+C^2]] decomposes under Fourier diagonalization into 2x2 blocks determinant 1, expanding exponent Phi(d)=2asinh(|d|/2); Haar entropy sums these exponents even with neutral factors. For n=3m graph is balanced complete tripartite, spectrum (2m,-m,-m,0^(n-3)), hence h=Phi(2m)+2Phi(m)=6log m+2log2+o(1). For n=3m+1 and 3m+2 the generating polynomials satisfy respectively (1+z+z^2)P+(1+z^2)=(1+z^2)Q and (1+z+z^2)P-z=z^2 Q; at all nontrivial n-th roots 1+z+z^2 !=0, giving exact spectra -2cos(theta)/(1+2cos(theta)) and 1/(1+2cos(theta)). An integrable logarithmic majorant, minimum sampled distance O(1/n) and O(delta|log delta|)+O(log n/n) uniform tail show the normalized Riemann sums converge to positive improper integrals c1,c2. The degree eigenvalue contributes O(log n/n). Independent Fourier eigenvalue checks verified every frequency for n=3..150 and same degree of n=3m and 3m+1. No inference from bounded testing to infinite limit.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge primary and published-record comparison distinguishes the final exact claim from the already known framework, special cases and methods; all specific gaps and accessible-text limits are documented, and failed searches alone are not treated as novelty proof. The congruence-three dichotomy explains a surprising entropy-density transition within an explicitly defined natural circulant coupling family: adjacent site counts have identical degree 2m yet one has logarithmic total entropy and the other extensive entropy. Exact spectral formulas and singular-integral asymptotics reveal a structural mechanism beyond numerical plots.
residual_risks: The 2026 primary source already uses the exact stride parameter and generic Fourier entropy expression, so the spectral simplifications are natural consequences; priority could exist in unindexed discussions or numerical appendices.
